_schema.note: Factions, civilizations and teams. 'gameplay_faction' links to data/enemies/factions.json where the faction is implemented as an enemy faction.

entries.name: Cindercrest
entries.ideology: Revanchist: favour the 'old players', kill new players or force them to work for Cindercrest, because the old players are 'starving'.
assets: Enough wealth to equip thousands of players with full netherite
Strongholds and an outpost in its territory
history: Massacred Skymore.
Won the Civil War: Fort Feather, Merchant City, Spawn, Highwater City, Capitol City, Steampunk City, Cindercrest outpost.
Seized Capital City and dethroned Parrot; Saparata crowned King.
Later fought the NULL over a captured stronghold.

entries.name: Parrot's Kingdom
entries.ideology: Protect new players; spawn with a blue castle and village; new players may live normally or join the Royal Army.
history: Formed after the Kings Arc election and the fall of LettuceK's Law.
Bordered by LAW City (south), Fort Feather (east), Newtopia (west), Ironclad City (north).
Destabilised by rushed policies; overthrown by Cindercrest.

entries.name: Kingdom of the Caves
entries.ideology: Establish Arachn1d as the rightful king.
history: Founded after the Kings Arc; grew in power.
Allied with Cindercrest against Parrot.
Arachn1d dethroned and killed by yungyx with Wemmbu.

entries.name: Spider Web Faction
entries.type: faction within the Kingdom of the Caves

entries.name: The Invisible Mafia
entries.ideology: Control the server through invisibility, coercion and resource destruction.
history: Destroyed farms and every reachable ominous spawner (making maces rare).
Destroyed the Far Lands Civilization.
Tore down Spawn to build a prison forcing new players to join.
Fell at the end of Season 1.

entries.name: The Law
entries.ideology: Order enforced through Lawmen, forts and prisons; corrupt under LettuceK.
assets: Northern Council (largest Law build, de-facto capital)
history: Hunted FlameFrags; imprisoned Lomedy.
Captured Wemmbu after Parrot unmasked him.
Lost its final battle to District 13; Lettuce surrendered.
Rebuilt by SargeLAW; neutral during the Civil War.

entries.name: District 13
entries.ideology: Resistance against the Mafia, later against the Law.
history: Founded after the Far Lands fell.
Defeated LettuceK's Law.

entries.name: Far Lands Civilization
entries.ideology: One of the last resistance cells against the Mafia; three districts (Builders, Farmers, Warriors) sorted by a wither-kill test with 5 chosen items; beacon signals to other cells.
history: Too remote for other cells to help; overrun by the Mafia in minutes.

entries.name: The Pirates
history: Invaded Wemmbu and Eggchan's civilization; Wemmbu killed most of them.

entries.name: Zam Empire
history: Wemmbu's Civilization was a colony until Zam's betrayal.
Fell to internal and external conflict (Wemmbu, ClownPierce, Reddoons).

entries.name: The NULL
entries.ideology: Reorganised by Spoke from dispersed bounty hunters into a full-scale army.
history: Captured a stronghold in Cindercrest territory.

entries.name: Bounty Assassin Team
entries.ideology: Investigate crimes and neutralise wanted players.
history: Featured in Season 2.

entries.name: Spoke Galactic Empire
history: BAT Arc.

entries.name: Skymore Civilization
entries.ideology: Safe haven for new players attacked by older ones.
history: 999 of 1,000 killed by ShoeBilly and Cindercrest during food expeditions.

entries.name: Skyblock Civilization
history: Raided by the Invisible Mafia; later dissolved.

entries.name: Ice Mountain Civilization
history: Taken over and destroyed by Fantst.

entries.name: Eggchan Empire
history: Invaded by the Pirates.

entries.name: Wemmbu's Civilization
history: Former colony of the PrinceZam Empire; declared independence after Zam's betrayal and griefing.

entries.name: Capital City / Capitol City
entries.ideology: Safe space for all players; desert-empire theme.
history: Site of the decisive Battle for Capital City.

entries.name: Toxic civilization (Toxic War Arc)
entries.leader: unnamed leader (beaten 1v1 by Flame); wiki summary names SpokeIsHere as leading the attacking group
history: Hunted Flame; destroyed by Flame with Lomedy's TNT cannons.

entries.name: NULL Hunters
history: Absorbed into the NULL under Spoke.
